propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust bounded request budgets with zero incrementally banked criterion verdicts due to Pydantic AI concurrent tool-batch execution defeating prompt-only banking serialization.
The completion contract requires banking verdicts incrementally so work survives bounded model runs, but the original implementation deferred all record calls until budget exhaustion.

A completion-only enforcement policy at the build_agent_kwargs seam must atomically claim one governed action per response, count evidence responses for the live first-unbanked criterion id, and invoke record_criterion_verdict as provisional met=false on the third response if still unbanked.

The original 9895 run observed zero bank writes after 24 requests and 37 distinct repository actions; the held-out dense oracle reproduced 0/3 bounded success before repair and achieved 2+/3 after the policy wrapper merged.
System guidance must express the banking contract as an affirmative finite state transition in the prompt, not rely on subjective evidence-sufficiency conditions or untrusted ticket-context wording.
